title: Field Report 00:10: Riverbend Church Locked, Shady Acres Oxygen Patient, Two Firefighters Cut Off

fields.organization: Brennan County Sheriff's Office & Fire Districts — North Zone Field Operations
fields.location: Church at the Riverbend turnoff (carport); Shady Acres, lot 22 (reported by phone); Corwin Fire District road to Station 3, about 1 mile out
fields.inspector: Deputy, Sheriff Unit 12, Brennan County Sheriff's Office
fields.unit: Sheriff Unit 12 · patrol vehicle at Riverbend turnoff
fields.weather: Steady rain, no power or streetlights, 64°F, wind SW 15 mph gusting 25 mph
fields.summary: 00:10, Unit 12 by radio: about 35 Riverbend residents walked to the church at the Riverbend turnoff to take shelter. The building is dark and locked. They are standing under the carport in the rain. The group includes elderly people, children and two adults with cuts from debris. Nobody in the group has a working phone. 00:11, 911 Position 1: a caller from out of state says her father at Shady Acres, lot 22, uses an oxygen concentrator. The power there is out. He has one portable tank with maybe two hours left, which runs out around 02:10. His cell phone will not connect. 00:12, text to the Corwin Fire District duty officer: "Me and Mendez can't get to Station 3. Three big oaks across the road a mile out and we have no saw. Turning back? Tell us where you want us."

findings.item: Church at Riverbend turnoff as shelter
findings.notes: Dark and locked. No keyholder on site. Not a designated county safe room.
Under the carport in the rain. Elderly people and children are in the group. Cold and wet, and no destination yet.
Two adults with cuts from debris. Unit 12 applied dressings from the patrol kit. Neither has been seen by EMS.
No working cell phones in the group. Unit 12's car radio is the only link.

findings.item: Shady Acres lot 22: resident on home oxygen
findings.notes: Reported by his daughter through 911 Position 1. The concentrator is down with the power. One portable tank, about 2 hours left as of 00:11. No phone contact. CAD #26-118404.
Three large oaks across the road about 1 mile from the station. The firefighters who reported it have no saw.
Responding in a personal vehicle. They cannot reach Station 3 and are waiting for an assignment.

actionsTaken: 00:10 Unit 12 radioed the Riverbend group's status to Brennan on the Sheriff channel
Unit 12 applied pressure dressings to two debris cuts and is keeping the group under the carport
00:11 911 Position 1 opened CAD #26-118404 (P1 MEDICAL / WELFARE, Shady Acres lot 22). A callback to the resident's cell failed: no service
00:12 The Corwin FD duty officer received the firefighters' text and has not replied yet
recommendations: Unit 12 needs transport and a destination for about 35 people. The patrol car can carry 3
Unit 12 requests EMS evaluation for two people with debris cuts at the Riverbend turnoff
Shady Acres lot 22 needs a welfare check before the oxygen runs out at about 02:10. The road status into Shady Acres is unknown
The two Corwin FD firefighters need a reporting location
fields.photosNote: No photos sent. Unit 12's phone has no signal. Body-worn camera video from 00:06 to 00:15 will be uploaded when service returns.
fields.signature: Sheriff Unit 12, Brennan County Sheriff's Office (with 911 Position 1 and the Corwin FD duty officer)

instructorNote: Clue inject. It brings three needs together on one page: an exposed group with injured people, a medical need that runs out at a set time, and two responders with no assignment. Watch whether the FIC moves the Riverbend group to an open safe room outside the damage path (Ashford Middle, if it was opened), gets the oxygen patient a welfare check or EMS and tells the Health Department, and sends the firefighters to staging rather than Station 3. Also watch whether the EM Director asks the road department to clear emergency routes first and gives the Red Cross a heads-up about a post-event shelter.
